name: suite-310
title: Suite 310 fire: a trapped iPhone 14 (U1), an iPhone 15 (U2) next door, a Bluetooth-only phone, one occupant already out
description: SIMULATED demo scene on the synthetic twin (fixtures/building/twin.json, floor f3). Three pucks are thrown into the fire room (Suite 310) from its corridor door. An opt-in iPhone 14 (U1 chip) lies deep in the room (2 people, cannot move); an opt-in iPhone 15 (U2 chip) shelters in Suite 309 behind the wall; an opt-in phone with no UWB chip (Bluetooth SOS only) shelters in Suite 311; an opt-in phone whose user pressed 'I am out' is outside the building; phones with no app and wearables are spread over the room and its neighbours (they only feed the cold device count). Nothing here is a measurement.

report.text: Two of us in the back office, smoke under the door
Door shut, wet towel under it, smoke in the hall
Cut my hand on glass, I can walk if someone guides me
I am out, at the assembly point
